cases.rationale: People crowd the street beside two identifiable full-size red/yellow buses. The young man at the left edge wears a gray/black backpack with a visible pack body and shoulder straps. A small partly occluded two-wheeler/rider-like form just left of the central bus leaves motorcycle identity unresolved (3); the detail does not support a definite motorcycle. Shop signs and printed imagery do not establish additional actual objects. All 75 definitions were individually considered; other listed categories have no identifiable actual instance.

This kitchen contains a stainless refrigerator, a microwave above a conventional built-in oven, and recognizable wooden chair backs at the left rear. The cooktop, hood and kettle are distinct from the listed appliances and bottle/cup definitions. The left rear eating-area surface is too occluded to establish a dining table rather than counter (60 unclear); a small silvery basin-like sliver at the far left of the island lacks sufficient sink bowl/tap context (71 unclear). Framed pictures are not TVs or actual depicted objects. All 75 definitions were individually considered.

A cropped human in a pale shirt and shorts is visible beside grass, dirt and unpotted trees. The raised arm/throwing pose does not supply a visible frisbee or other sports object. Trees without containers do not meet potted plant. All 75 definitions were individually considered; no other actual category object is identifiable and there is no unresolved category ambiguity.

Several actual people are visible on the ski slope and outside the lift/station building. The upright equipment in the foreground consists of narrow paired skis in a metal rack, without an identifiable snowboard deck/binding; the rack is not a bench or dining table. The hut, signs and lift structures do not establish any other listed actual object. All 75 definitions were individually considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual child fills the foreground, with part of a black folding chair and its crossed frame/legs visible behind her at upper right. The colorful shirt lettering and bug/flower graphics are printed decoration, not actual category objects. Grass is unpotted. All 75 definitions were individually considered; no further actual category object or unresolved category ambiguity is visible.

A large pedestal dining table sits inside long built-in upholstered banquette benches intended for multiple people. Their continuous booth construction supports bench rather than individual chair or couch. A small microwave with dark window/control area is visible in the rear kitchen. The tiny dark upright object on the back counter could be a bottle or another kitchen container/grinder; its neck/body detail is inadequate (39 unclear). The tabletop centerpiece is a napkin/condiment holder, without vase or drinking-vessel identity. All 75 definitions were individually considered.

A tennis player holds an actual strung tennis racket on the court, with additional cropped people along the top edge. The court boundary and advertising fixtures are not household furniture or traffic signs. No fielding glove or other listed sports equipment is visible. All 75 definitions were individually considered; no other identifiable actual category object or unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual elephant stands on the paved sidewalk; a pigeon is visible in front of it, people occupy the distant walkway, and several long public benches line the trees. White passenger-car bodies are visible across the road. The cropped orange passenger vehicle at the extreme right lacks enough detail to distinguish road bus from rail tram (5 and 6 unclear). A tiny signal-like head near that right background is insufficiently resolved to confirm a traffic signal (9 unclear). Unpotted trees and bench frames do not add other categories. All 75 definitions were individually considered.

A sleeping child's face and arm are visible at lower left on an actual bed with pillows and extensive bedding. Rounded-eared stuffed bear toys with soft bodies and muzzle features lie among the pillows near the upper center/right, supporting teddy bear; their plush/toy context excludes actual bear or other live animal labels. The dark exposure still permits these identities. All 75 definitions were individually considered; no additional listed object or unresolved category ambiguity.

An actual man holds a wooden strung tennis racket toward the camera, with several people behind him in a dim interior. Small reflective upright vessel-like forms at the lower-left bar area are too blurred to resolve bottles versus drinking cups or bar fittings; bottle (39) and cup (41) remain unclear. No bowl-stem-foot wine-glass form can be identified. The bar surface does not establish a dining table. All 75 definitions were individually considered.

A large actual cow's head/neck fills the right side of the beach scene. Colorful pole-supported beach parasols are umbrellas, and individual wooden reclining lounge chairs are chairs rather than benches or beds. A small standing human is visible near the water between the central umbrellas. Low beach furniture does not establish a dining table, and the sea contains no identifiable boat. All 75 definitions were individually considered; no unresolved category ambiguity.

A child sits in an actual sink basin beneath a faucet, holding visible narrow-handled bristled toothbrushes. A dark bottle with a narrow capped neck and wider body stands at the right. The white perforated cylinder at left is a bathroom holder, not an identifiable drinking cup. A small translucent vessel near the left of the faucet is too indistinct to settle tumbler versus toiletry container, so cup (41) remains unclear. The mirror and toiletries are not TV, laptop or toilet fixtures. All 75 definitions were individually considered.
